summary: Test whether zebrafish larvae are significantly self-similar across days by splitting the cross-day FC-similarity matrix into intra-individual (diagonal) and inter-individual (off-diagonal) groups and comparing them with a two-sided Mann-Whitney U test, then plotting both distributions as jittered scatter points under unfilled min-to-max boxplots with the p-value annotated.
use_when: Run the Significance of FC fingerprinting: intra- vs inter-individual similarity recipe

Test whether zebrafish larvae are significantly self-similar across days by splitting the cross-day FC-similarity matrix into intra-individual (diagonal) and inter-individual (off-diagonal) groups and comparing them with a two-sided Mann-Whitney U test, then plotting both distributions as jittered scatter points under unfilled min-to-max boxplots with the p-value annotated.
avoid_when: Independent biological replicates or an appropriate null model are unavailable
